# Epoch 14 Rules [italic]Epoch 14 is a roleplaying game with team deathmatch elements. This means players are expected, to an extent, to pretend their character is part of this world in their actions and words. This is the intended experience, and the experience the players of Epoch 14 enjoy, and is not always about winning.[/italic]
## Recent Changes Read the relevant sections for the entire text.
## 1. Game Administrator Discretion
- a. Game administrators may take action dispensing with or interpreting any server rules or administrator policies at any time according to their reasonable discretion in maintaining the best interests of the players and the server. - b. Any decision by game administrators pursuant to 1a may be appealed to head administrators via the server's discord tickets.
## 2. No Erotic Role Play (ERP) - a. ERP is strictly prohibited in this server, including the roleplaying or description of any sexual act or commonly sexualized body part.
## 3. Cheating - a. The use of external software, aside from an information guide, to gain an unfair advantage in-game is prohibited. - b. The use of an external communications platform, metacomms, to gain an unfair advantage in-game is prohibited. - c. The exploitation of unintended game mechanics to gain an unfair advantage in-game is prohibited.
## 4. Minimum Age - a. To connect to and play in this server while being under the age of 18 is prohibited.
## 5. Respect - a. Insulting and antagonizing other characters when reasonably roleplaying is permitted. - b. Insulting, antagonizing, or otherwise discriminating against other persons is otherwise prohibited. - c. Raising, discussing or engaging with allegations of criminal conduct by administration or staff members of other servers is strictly prohibited, within the understanding of United States criminal laws.
## 7. Roleplay - a. You are expected to roleplay your character reasonably in a Medium Role Play (MRP) server. However, the intention is to allow a free direction in role play to the extent that most players can still enjoy the game. Examples may be listed below: - i. A group of unfairly repressed workers who secretly stockpile weapons for use in an armed revolt against their oppressors, is permitted. - ii. A group of server raiders join the server and immediately begin assaulting other characters with a crowbar with little to no roleplay, is prohibited. - b. Reasonably co-operating or engaging in antagonist activity against other characters is permitted.
